== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow was born on 26 April 1787 according to the held OPR derivative, which names his father [[Glasgow-1382|Thomas Glasgow]] and mother [[Davidson-14073|Christian (Christine) Davidson]]. It gives baptism on 6 May at Whitburn and residence Blackburn.<ref name="Thomas1787OPR">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', Thomas Glasgow, birth 26 April 1787, baptism 6 May 1787, Whitburn, residence Blackburn, parents Thomas Glasgow and Christian Davidson, OPR 673/1 item 3 page 61; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4171361 SCOT/OPR/BAP/4171361], inspected derivative retained from 30 October 2026; original register uninspected.</ref> Companion indexes instead label 26 April as baptism at Livingston with the same complete parental couple.<ref name="Thomas1787Companions">Findmypast, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685840829 R_685840829] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_692406064 R_692406064], held inspected derivatives, 30 October 2026; companion indexes, not independent witnesses.</ref> The accepted explicit birth date and existing parish context remain, with the baptism/locality disagreement stated. His existing father is assessed at 97% confident for the recorded-child relationship; this does not identify every later adult called Thomas or prove his father's childhood.

[[Chapman-19354|Sarah Chapman]] remains his existing, unassessed tree spouse. The retained 1880 marriage extract for Henry Glasgow names a father Thomas, but does not identify that father with this 1787 child. No spouse or child attachment is newly made, no later adult identity is settled, and his death remains unknown.
